environment: Linux datacenter VM; no browser profile, user cookies, API keys, or logged-in sessions
scope: Live route assessment for social-fetch gaps. Raw route probes are distinguished from integrated Client/download/export verification.

tooling.probe_bound: 55 seconds per URL; socket timeout 15 seconds; one retry; no playlist; skip download
tooling.transfer_bound: 512 MiB per source; 300-second per-source deadline; 20-second connect/read timeout; allowlisted original and CDN hosts; manual redirect validation
tooling.media_validation: ffprobe stream inspection plus one-second ffmpeg video decode
